hypotheses.paper: k une partie convexe de S(E)

l = linearSubvariety L is part of the definition (L unique: linearSubvariety_injective)

hypotheses.paper: un sous-espace vectoriel L de E, variété d'appui de F(k)+{O}
hypotheses.note: L : Submodule ℝ E, IsVarieteAppui (kPrime k) L.toAffineSubspace (strict Déf. 3)

questions: l.289-290 « Si ce noyau est vide, il constitue une variété d'appui, ou encore une facette, de k de dimension (−1) »: the k-facettes of Déf. 4 (IsFacetteK) are nonempty, so ∅ is a facette only by the convention this sentence introduces. Reading taken: the facettes of k in the extended sense are the projections ofCone G of the k′-facettes G (IsFacetteKExt); G = {O} is a k′-facette exactly when the noyau is empty and projects to ∅, of dimension dimS ∅ = −1 (noyau_eq_empty_facette_dim, isFacetteKExt_iff). The mark rests on Déf. 6 itself (l.283-287, the row's span), which needs no reading; the commentary is proved under this reading.

transfers_p262.note: « Les propositions 5 et 6 sont également valables pour les convexes de S(E) »: no ledger row (OQ-160 (c)); proved as lemmas through k′ from the strict Chapter3/Appui
prop6: Benzecri.Sphere.facetteK_inter_eq (the proof's consequence, l a variété d'appui)
transfers_p262.reading: Prop. 5 on S(E) holds with « facette » in the extended sense (the facette ∅ of dimension −1 of l.289-290) and fails for genuine k-facettes exactly when l ∩ k = ∅, which forces noyau k = ∅ (example: the arc, l = ∅). The support of a part of S(E) is supportK (strict FacettesSphere).

instances.statement: the line ℝe₀ of S(1) gives a variété d'appui of the closed quarter arc arcS1
the diagonal line ℝ(e₀+e₁) does not give a variété d'appui of arcS1
∅ is a variété d'appui of arcS1 (its noyau is empty), and every genuine k-facette f has supportK f ∩ arcS1 ≠ ∅: Prop. 5 on S(E) needs the facette of dimension −1

kb_proposals: Chapter3/AppuiSphere: a variété d'appui of k ⊆ S(E) (Déf. 6) is IsVarieteAppuiK k l; directly, l is a linear subvariety containing noyau k with l ∩ k α(k)-saturated (isVarieteAppuiK_iff_alphaK). Saturation at O in k′ is exactly noyau ⊆ l, and l ∩ k may be empty (iff noyau k = ∅).

Transfer of a § 1 affine result about a k′-facette G to S(E): G is a positive cone, so (affineSpan G : Set E) = span G (coe_affineSpan_eq_span_of_isPosCone) and supportK (ofCone G) = linearSubvariety (span G). G = {O} projects to ∅ (ofCone_singleton_zero): keep it as the facette of dimension −1 (IsFacetteKExt) rather than excluding it.
kPrime (k ∩ linearSubvariety L) = kPrime k ∩ L (kPrime_inter_linearSubvariety): sections of a convex part of S(E) by linear subvarieties reduce to the affine W ∩ L of Chapter3/Appui.
